paper_title: Search for Axionlike-Particle-Induced Prompt Gamma-Ray Emission from Extragalactic Core-Collapse Supernovae with the Fermi Large Area Telescope
coupling_convention: g_agamma in GeV^-1 (plot axis labeled g_agamma in units of 10^-11 GeV^-1; axis multiplier applied)
notes: Fermi-LAT search for ALP-induced prompt gamma-ray bursts from 20 extragalactic core-collapse SNe (type Ib/c). No signal found; combined 95% CL limit excludes g_agamma > 2.6e-11 GeV^-1 (with 95% spread +2.0/-0.7e-11) for m_a < 3e-10 eV, assuming 10 Msun progenitors, NiCo light-curve model, and JF12 GMF model. Paper states limits extend to arbitrarily low masses (conversion probability mass-independent for m_a < 0.5 neV), so encoded as a flat bound down to 1e-12 eV. Limit valid under assumption at least one SN was in LAT field of view (probability 88.5%). Not a dark-matter search, so no local DM density assumed. Limits degrade above ~1 neV but numerical values there are only available from Fig. 2, not extractable from text.
